Contract AirportSystem::createDevice(id: Integer,name: String,location: String,contactsid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		device: Device = Device.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		staffMember: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = contactsid)
	precondition:
		Staff.allInstance()->includes(staffMember)
	postcondition:
		let success: Boolean = if device.oclIsUndefined() 
		then (let newDevice: Device in
		newDevice.oclIsNew() and
		newDevice.Id = id and
		newDevice.Name = name and
		newDevice.Location = location and
		newDevice.Contacts->includes(staffMember)) 
		else (device.Id = id and
		device.Name = name and
		device.Location = location and
		device.Contacts->includes(staffMember)) 
		endif  in
		result = success
}
